text.p: These are the leading stories in the Zimbabwe press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
_ Former Zimbabwean president Canaan Banana has described as "pathological lies" the sodomy and homosexuality charges levelled against him by various individuals.
- Spoornet of South Africa is withdrawing its passenger train service from Zimbabwe after a 28 percent increase in haulage charges announced by the National Railways of Zimbabwe.
- Zimbabwe's automotive and oil industries have been gripped by allegations that contaminated fuel is being sold to motorists.

- Proceedings at the CITES conference were disrupted for more than five minutes when delegates broke into song soon after three southern African countries were granted permission to conditionally resume international trade in ivory and other elephant products.
- More than 3.6 kg of cocaine concealed in cans meant for dog food has been seized and a suspected member of a drug ring believed to be based in Cape Town has been arrested, police said on Thursday.
